physical_site_rule.source_site: Original Event locationID normalized NFKD→uppercase ASCII alphanumeric. Key identical across visits only when same original author identity, not nearest coordinates or name.
physical_site_rule.original_source_same_site_method_variati: UV and bait are independent methods in same plot, counted as sampling opportunities, never as separate sites.
physical_site_rule.source_event_Date: Original Event date YYYY-MM-DD only; year and source explicit year if present must agree, quarter from calendar months
physical_site_rule.source_site_habitat_immutable: All original Event source habitat categories for one physical site must agree or unknown; contradictory native vs mixed/exotic requires scientific STOP.

habitat_ontology_locked_before_first_ori.primary_reference: Native Laurissilva / laurel forest versus altered forest (mixed or exotic); do not use agricultural, coastal or other Natura 2000 types as altered forests.
habitat_ontology_locked_before_first_ori.classification: casefold NFKD ASCII, collapse whitespace and punctuation. If excluded nonforest appears, exclude even when native word appears; altered mixed/exotic overrides native. If both mixed and exotic words exist, altered; if native-only, native. Unknown habitat never inferred from species, ALAN, location or Natura 2000 protected status.

capture_method_rule.primary: UV HEATH LIGHT trap only, never combine with wine-rope bait within any source richness estimator.
capture_method_rule.method_unknown: Any original method not classifiable as LIGHT or BAIT is excluded from candidate but counted; if >10% of source Events are UNKNOWN, TERMINAL.
capture_method_rule.method_conflict: If one original Event source method string maps to both LIGHT and BAIT, ambiguous and TERMINAL.

predeclared_eligibility.site_contrast: Among LIGHT trap Events in the same calendar year×quarter, at least two independent native Laurissilva physical sites and two altered mixed/exotic forest sites with one original LIGHT Event at each.
predeclared_eligibility.qualified_site_occurrence_mode: For each eligible year×quarter×author original physical site, take lexicographically earliest original Event core ID, so duplicate site visits cannot weight a site twice within one time stratum.
predeclared_eligibility.source_temporal_strata_frozen: 2022 Q3 or Q4 and 2023 Q1 or Q2 as observed from dataset; year-quarter groups computed from original source dates. Do NOT select only seasons where native origin later appears more distinct.
predeclared_eligibility.source_site_nonforest_exclusion: Exclude original agricultural/coastal sources from native vs altered forest comparison, but preserve counts of excluded sites.
predeclared_eligibility.original_47_vs_48_site_discrepancy: If original unique ID count is neither 47 nor 48, STOP; no coordinate-nearest merge.
predeclared_eligibility.if_gate_fails: TERMINAL independent Madeira source habitat test without source species/Occurrence read; do not rescue via moth taxon-specific origin, all methods pooling, original sampling season or a weaker two-site threshold.

future_if_eligible.v331: Freeze exact author taxon-origin ontology (endemic vs non-endemic native vs introduced; migratory distinct/unknown), identified species/subspecies ranks, exclusion of absence records, source Event to Occurrence join, within-year/quarter native vs altered forest absolute richness comparison in Madeira LIGHT trap Events. Only once these are code-frozen can occurrence original be opened one time.
future_if_eligible.comparator_Azores: Separate pinned SLAM native−altered richness directions, NOT cross-method pooled effect or meta-analytic significance. Madeira n=1 island, not independent three-island landscape replication.
future_if_eligible.cause_limits: ALAN/night trapping attracts animals from distance; canopy/environmental and temporal confound, no true species persistence or forest manipulation.
